✨ NEW: LED lighting on slatted panels
• Tap the slatted panel in 3D and place a vertical LED strip in any gap you choose.
• Pick the length from a drawing: full, half or a quarter, from the top or from the bottom.
• One tap on Cascade builds the effect across 3 gaps.
• 9 light colors, 3 profile colors and a night view button.
• Every strip goes straight into the materials list with its length.

💡 LED on shelves: one tap and it lights up.

🪚 Cabinetmaking the way you build
• Sides on the outside: square side panel, no rabbet, with the front rail screwed from the side.
• Corner cabinets in both builds: sides on the inside or on the outside.
• Toe kick with its own settings and a metal feet option.

⚡ Faster notes: writing and moving the page is smoother.

Plus more fixes and improvements across the editor.
